name: Akashi Kanade
source:
2nd-year High School student.

He's insecure about his short height. Because of that, he can't stand when he's teased for it. He's good at taking care of people, but hates to rely on others.

[From [url=http://honeyapple.html.xdomain.jp/game01/chara.html]official website[/url]]
